method: Ordered lexical comparison per module, with a consistent bijection restricted to explicitly declared generated internal wire identifiers. All other tokens, including instance names, ports, literals, primitive types, directives and punctuation must match exactly. Full-line metadata comments only are excluded.
limitation: This proves the emitted Verilog token/connectivity description differs only by permitted internal wire renames if passed; it does not prove RTL-to-netlist correctness or physical implementation/timing.
conclusion: Strict proof FAILED: differences include hierarchical UART/telemetry port renames busy to busy_Z and busy_11 to busy_8, beyond permitted internal generated-wire renames. No token count changes observed; full connectivity equivalence requires additional hierarchical port-aware analysis. Critical freshness-path assurance remains separate.
